instruction: The last Venmo payment request I sent to Cory was an accident and they approved it. Send them the money back.
notes: Two-app task (phone for contact lookup, venmo for the refund). supervisor.show_profile exposes the login usernames (phone number for phone, email for venmo); show_account_passwords exposes passwords. phone.search_contacts (query=Cory) yields Cory's email, which gates venmo.show_sent_payment_requests (status=approved) that discovers the latest approved request to Cory and its amount (static request-to/request-status/request-amount facts stand in for the unknown runtime values). venmo.create_transaction must use the discovered email and the request's amount; its effect (refunded req) is the single goal condition besides (task-completed). supervisor-complete-task takes the refunded request as a non-API task-record parameter and is forced last by (not (task-completed)) on all other actions. Description is modeled because the reference solution passes it; evaluation only checks receiver and amount.
